Best Lasagne in Town
Nov 2020
I have only sampled two different dishes in The Loop, mainly because the beef lasagne is so delicious that I tend to just order this time and time again. Unlike the tomato type lasagne with an over abundance of fresh tomato sauce in many other restaurants, the Loop's beef lasagne is a cheesy, meaty version which is really hearty and extremely delicious. I usually order French fries with the lasagne for a bit of self - indulgence, and not really liking their mixture of large and thin French fries, the staff, when asked, are very happy just to make thin French fries instead. The French fries are quite pleasant and the two dipping sauces which come with them are super tasty and quite addictive! I have only been to the restaurant once and that's when I decided to try something different. I ordered the Tagliolini which consisted of parma ham, mushrooms and a mushroom sauce. It was quite pleasant but I think the taste wasn't really for me. There was absolutely nothing wrong with the dish but it just wasn't my type of flavour. However, it was disappointing that it was only barely luke warm and even after being heated again it was only a little warmer. This surprised me as even after travelling quite some distance, the many lasagnes I have had delivered are still hot on arrival. But I put it down to a glitch on the day. But for now I will continue with the tried and tested best-in-town lasagnes. Special mention must be made to the staff, whether on the phone or in person, they are amongst the warmest , most helpful and welcoming staff anywhere. The Loop, along with one other western restaurant (and every single Indian restaurant) was one of the few that we approached who agreed to deliver to the other side of District 2, to Thanh My Loi, during the Covid restricted working period. Most restaurants said that that part of District 2 was too far and refused. As there is very little in the way of restaurants and deliveries in Thanh My Loi, me and my team were extremely appreciative of The Loop and a handful of others who were prepared to make the trip. In return, we will continue to support The Loop although that's no hardship due to their tasty food and friendly team. Looking forward to my next trip to Thao Dien to sample their food again.
